title: Cover shows real workspace state
description: The admin home /admin renders the editorial cover with real data: edition state in the masthead, real numbers and featured tables.

steps.description: Navigate to /login
Fill in the username field with testadmin
Fill in the password field with TestAdmin123!
Submit the login form
Verify the browser lands on /admin showing the editorial cover (light paper card) with the page header 'Estado da edição'
Verify the masthead eyebrow shows one of: 'Edição nº', 'nenhuma edição no ar' or 'rascunho · não publicado'
Verify the 'Em números' aside shows at least 4 numeric stats (tabelas, registros, edições, grupos)
Verify the section 'I · Tabelas em destaque' lists at least one table with its record/column counts, OR shows the empty-state CTA
Verify NO hardcoded fake data appears: no 'Uptime', no 'SQLite local', no 'v1.3.0' anywhere on the page

title: Fresh admin sees draft cover with publish CTA
description: An admin that never published sees 'rascunho · não publicado' and a CTA to publish the first edition.

steps.description: Navigate to /login and log in as master puczaras / Zup Paras
Create a new admin account with a unique username (e.g. coverfresh<random>) and password CoverFresh123! in the admin management view
Log out and log in with the freshly created admin
Verify the cover at /admin shows 'rascunho · não publicado' in the masthead
Verify section 'III · Edições publicadas' shows 'Nenhuma edição publicada ainda' with the link 'Publicar a primeira →'
Verify the 'Pré-visualizar' and 'Copiar link' buttons are disabled

title: Copy link gives visual feedback
description: Clicking 'Copiar link' on a workspace with published editions shows the 'copiado ✓' feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /login and log in as testadmin / TestAdmin123!

On /admin, if the 'Copiar link' button is disabled: open 'Publicação' in the sidebar, make a small edit so the draft becomes dirty, publish via 'Publicar mudanças' + confirm, then return to /admin (Capa in the sidebar)
Click the 'Copiar link' button in the page header
Verify the button briefly changes to 'copiado ✓'

title: Sidebar reaches Capa and Publish Studio
description: The sidebar has working entries for Capa (/admin) and Publicação (/admin/publish) — the studio used to be unreachable.

steps.description: Navigate to /login and log in as testadmin / TestAdmin123!
Click 'Publicação' in the sidebar
Verify the Publish Studio loads at /admin/publish (tabs Aparência/Conteúdo/Publicação visible)
Click 'Capa' in the sidebar
Verify the editorial cover loads back at /admin
Click 'QR' in the sidebar (Acesso group)
Verify the QR page loads at /admin/qr-auth without a 404
